Notes: ICC Immigration Officer (NEOB), Arrival hall (4604) at (192.3, 1.0, 163.4). Rebuilt from 3 QuestDialogCapture dumps (ICC_Immigration_Officer_NEOB, 2026-10-20, character Soldaman, no quest state).

questions.Text: Yes, thank you.  I've got some questions for you, if you've got time.

not_sure.Text: I'm not sure where to go from here.

jobe_program.Text: What can you tell me of the Jobe Research Program?

luck.Text: Wow, sounds exciting! Thanks for the information. Wish me luck!

Text: Greetings, newcomer!
{delay 2}\nI trust your trip from the Morningstar Space Station was a safe one.

absolutely.Text: Absolutely.  That's what I'm here for.

Text: Well, I'm sure you've overheard conversations of the travellers while going through the Arrival Hall.
{delay 4}\nAnd perhaps you've also had a chance to chat with them.
{delay 2}\nSome of them have settled down on Rubi-Ka, and others have chosen to join the Jobe Research Program.
{delay 4}  The choice is up to you.
Due to heavy immigration and colonization of Rubi-Ka and the recent Alien attacks, security measures have been increased.
{delay 5}\nIf you choose to immigrate to Rubi-Ka, you'll be shuttled to the ICC Shuttleport until background checks have been run and you can be granted proper citizenship.
{delay 6}\nThe ICC Shuttleport is located in the ocean off the southern coast of terraformed Rubi-Ka.
{delay 4}\nWhile you're there, you'll also go through some basic orientation and training.

orientation.Text: You'll be given the opportunity to better familiarize yourself with the basics of Rubi-Ka wildlife, technology, and survival techniques.

Text: It's an exciting time to immigrate to Rubi-Ka.
{delay 2}\nThere are a lot of new towns being established throughout Rubi-Ka, but be careful of the Alien threat.
{delay 3}\n{emote}The ICC Immigration Officer pauses for a moment and looks at you intently.{/emote}
{delay 5}\nBut perhaps...
{delay 2}that's why you are coming here at this time...
{delay 3} to fulfill your destiny.
{delay 3}\nTo protect and defend Humanity against the Alien threat.
{delay 2}\n{emote}He smiles at you and nods knowingly.{/emote}
Safe travels to you, newcomer!
{delay 2}\nMay the twin suns of Rubi-Ka always shine on you.
I suggest you go have a chat with the Jobe Research Scientist over there.
{delay 3}\nShe can answer your questions.
